headline: Siegfried Mureșan responds to scenarios about new taxes: "We don't need them" / Announced goal for VAT
summary: Designated Prime Minister Siegfried Mureșan said his goal is to return VAT to 19% once the budget allows. He rejected new taxes, levies or VAT increases, favouring spending cuts.
why: Tax and VAT policy shapes Romania's budget deficit, which drives government bond issuance and sovereign credit assessments.
